title: Stop agents from assuming the user is the program lead
summary: The agent guides named approvals by first name, so Claude Code and Codex addressed other contributors by that name. The guides now name the program lead role, and AGENTS.md maps that role to GitHub user palerdr and tells agents not to assume the user's identity.
next: Contributors merge main into open branches so their agents read the corrected guides.
reason: A wording change in agent guides changes no measured result, roadmap marker or gate.
